reference.source: Dhingra Diseases of ENT 8th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Pleomorphic adenoma: excise with margin, never enucleate
Smaller gland tumour, higher cancer probability
Frey syndrome is gustatory sweating after parotid surgery
reference.pathophysiology: Calcium rich stagnant saliva precipitates stones against gravity in Wharton duct, while autoimmune lymphoepithelial destruction and slow neoplastic growths with perineural affinity define tumour behaviours by gland site.
additionalDifferentials: Bacterial versus viral parotitis by laterality and pus
Pleomorphic adenoma versus Warthin by age, sex, bilaterality
Sjogren swelling versus lymphoma transformation (persistent hard mass)
additionalInvestigations: Ultrasound first for stones and masses, sialendoscopy
MRI parotid and fine needle aspiration for tumours
Schirmer, anti Ro La and lip biopsy for Sjogren
